    "definition": "Credit-claiming occurs when a senator explicitly attributes a positive outcome, action, or achievement to their own efforts, work, or advocacy, thereby taking personal responsibility for the result.",
    "clarification": "Credit-claiming is identified when the senator uses first-person language (e.g., 'I secured,' 'I authored,' 'I worked to ensure') or explicitly links their actions to a successful outcome. This includes announcing funding, legislation, or other achievements as a direct result of their personal involvement. The focus is on the senator's explicit assertion of their role in bringing about the result.",
